USAGE:
    bnl-dotnet [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    bnl-dotnet basic
    bnl-dotnet basic --interactive
    bnl-dotnet basic OrderService.Create
    bnl-dotnet basic ./MyApi.csproj OrderService.Create(int)
    bnl-dotnet endpoint

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    basic            Free. Diagram a single method in isolation - no            
                     composition, no license needed. Give no method to list them
    endpoint         Paid. Controller actions (ASP.NET Core Web API entry       
                     points). Give no action to list them                       
    method           Paid. Any analyzable method, not just controller actions.  
                     Give no method to list them                                
    license <key>    Activate a license key

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Free. Diagram a single method in isolation - no composition, no license needed. 
Give no method to list them

USAGE:
    bnl-dotnet basic [path-or-method] [method] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    bnl-dotnet basic
    bnl-dotnet basic --interactive
    bnl-dotnet basic OrderService.Create
    bnl-dotnet basic ./MyApi.csproj OrderService.Create(int)

ARGUMENTS:
    [path-or-method]    A .sln, .slnx or .csproj (or a folder containing one).  
                        Omit to use the one in the current folder; if it's not a
                        project, it's read as the method instead                
    [method]            The method to diagram, e.g. OrdersController.Get or     
                        OrdersController.Get(int). Omit to list what's available

OPTIONS:
                             DEFAULT                                            
    -h, --help                          Prints help information                 
    -o, --output                        File to write the diagram to, or a      
                                        folder to write <Type.Method>.mmd into. 
                                        Defaults to the current folder          
        --stdout                        Write the diagram to STDOUT and nothing 
                                        else (for redirects and pipes). Cannot  
                                        be combined with -o                     
    -f, --format <FORMAT>    mermaid    mermaid (bare diagram text, .mmd) or    
                                        markdown (wrapped in a ```mermaid fence,
                                        .md)                                    
    -i, --interactive                   Choose the method from a menu (type to  
                                        filter, up/down to page) instead of     
                                        naming it                               
    -q, --quiet                         Suppress informational output           
        --verbose                       Show every
[truncated]
